criteria: Independent review found the submitted telemetry source cannot provide a live FPS in the actual standalone client.
evidence: The candidate reads snapshot.visualFps, but the actual standalone-client observation established that it is always null. Existing live measured telemetry is performance.worker.produced.value, as displayed by PerformanceStatus. Therefore the header always shows the fallback instead of a measured live FPS. The submission also records that its isolated 640x360 capture did not render because of a draft-version race, so the required capture is absent. Correct the source and submit fresh focused and isolated evidence.
